description:
The image shows a white Delta airplane with red and blue accents on the tail, on a gray background behind a tall, brown tower. 

The airplane is centered in the image and is flying towards the right side of the image. It has a white body with the word "DELTA" printed in red on the side. The tail of the plane is red and blue, and the wings are white.

In the background, there is a tall, brown tower that appears to be an air traffic control
